items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: We have a few things, we're having a few things sent up, Sam. Would you like something?

ctx.x: Where are you going? Where are you going having fun like that? Obviously I didn't go home for three or four weeks. There'd be two or three girls on the block. And I used to, where I used to play at, I could look out the window the girls hustling, you know. And the clarinet player, Louie Nelson used to work down there with us too in the district. And I had a piece of chalk and I used to watch through this window how many tricks, every time she turned a trick, you know, she'd watch it come and throw it in the door…

Yeah, sure. How are you? How are you? How are you? How are you, man? All right. We have a few things, we're having a few things sent up, Sam. Would you like something? No, I just have my lunch, thanks. Some tea? No, I didn't. Nothing? Just have my lunch. Want a drink? No, I don't drink.
I used to sit there and watch them throw that pee out the window, you know.
